statement: At pinned Cemu 29f2f1f the normal reader constructs WiimoteState.motion_sample using processed acceleration and magnitude of acceleration change while supplying zero-valued arrays for its remaining motion arguments. NativeWiimoteController::get_motion_sample forwards this provider sample rather than consuming the separately stored MotionPlus orientation. As written this exported path cannot evidence decoded MotionPlus angular velocity even if raw packets arrive; no assertion that all possible Cemu motion paths behave alike.

applicability.revision: Pinned consumer implementations in docs/wii-motionplus-consumer-comparison.md; no physical Wii Remote revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Cemu provider.cpp 675-719; provider.h 43-73; NativeWiimoteController.cpp 128-142. Source-only sampled exported API, not a host/application result.
